title: expressjs/express: res.send drops the ETag with Transfer-Encoding
trap: A subtle interaction in lib/response.js of a large real codebase (1,260 tests). Real fix #7459 (Sep 2026).
prompt: When a handler sets `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and then calls `res.send('hello')`, the response no longer has an ETag header, although ETags are enabled. Content-Length must still be left out when Transfer-Encoding is set. Please fix it and add a test to test/res.send.js. Reply with a short summary for the PR.
